targets.rawSql: SELECT ta.relayer AS provider, count() AS "Transactions", round(sum(gt.balance_deltas[acct]) / 1e9, 4) AS "Total tips (SOL)", round(sum(gt.fee_sol), 4) AS "Total fees (SOL)", round(median(gt.balance_deltas[acct])) AS "Median tip (lamports)", round(median(gt.fee_sol) * 1e9) AS "Median fee (lamports)" FROM default.geyser_transactions gt ARRAY JOIN arrayConcat(gt.static_unsigned_writable_accounts, gt.loaded_writable_accounts) AS acct INNER JOIN default.tip_accounts ta ON ta.tip_account = acct WHERE gt.is_vote = 0 AND gt.balance_deltas[acct] > 0 AND $__timeFilter(gt.ingested_at) AND ta.relayer IN (${provider:singlequote}) GROUP BY provider ORDER BY count() DESC

panels.title: Tipping transactions over time by provider

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(gt.ingested_at) AS time, countIf(ta.relayer = 'temporal') AS temporal, countIf(ta.relayer = 'astralane') AS astralane, countIf(ta.relayer = 'jito') AS jito, countIf(ta.relayer = 'bloxroute') AS bloxroute, countIf(ta.relayer = '0slot') AS "0slot", countIf(ta.relayer = 'helius') AS helius, countIf(ta.relayer = 'stellium') AS stellium, countIf(ta.relayer = 'blockrazor') AS blockrazor, countIf(ta.relayer = 'temporal_private') AS temporal_private FROM default.geyser_transactions gt ARRAY JOIN arrayConcat(gt.static_unsigned_writable_accounts, gt.loaded_writable_accounts) AS acct INNER JOIN default.tip_accounts ta ON ta.tip_account = acct WHERE gt.is_vote = 0 AND gt.balance_deltas[acct] > 0 AND $__timeFilter(gt.ingested_at) AND ta.relayer IN (${provider:singlequote}) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT ta.relayer AS provider, count() AS transactions FROM default.geyser_transactions gt ARRAY JOIN arrayConcat(gt.static_unsigned_writable_accounts, gt.loaded_writable_accounts) AS acct INNER JOIN default.tip_accounts ta ON ta.tip_account = acct WHERE gt.is_vote = 0 AND gt.balance_deltas[acct] > 0 AND $__timeFilter(gt.ingested_at) AND ta.relayer IN (${provider:singlequote}) GROUP BY provider ORDER BY transactions DESC

SELECT ta.relayer AS provider, round(sum(gt.balance_deltas[acct]) / 1e9, 4) AS total_tips_sol FROM default.geyser_transactions gt ARRAY JOIN arrayConcat(gt.static_unsigned_writable_accounts, gt.loaded_writable_accounts) AS acct INNER JOIN default.tip_accounts ta ON ta.tip_account = acct WHERE gt.is_vote = 0 AND gt.balance_deltas[acct] > 0 AND $__timeFilter(gt.ingested_at) AND ta.relayer IN (${provider:singlequote}) GROUP BY provider ORDER BY total_tips_sol DESC
